I sit here thinking about my 14 mu. I am alone in the house now, 59 years old, been doing this 40 years. My body is not what it was. I grow chili mostly — that is my main crop. The other things, cotton and garlic and watermelon and wheat, I do small pieces when I have strength.

Chili in Quzhou pays good when the price is right. My neighbors all do chili here. I put most of my land in chili, maybe 8 mu. Cotton 2 mu because the price is not so good anymore and it needs much spraying. Garlic 1.5 mu — garlic is heavy work for one old woman but the money is good. Watermelon 1 mu for selling at the roadside and eating. Wheat 1.5 mu — wheat is easy, the machine does everything, and I get flour for myself.

For chili, I use the seedlings from the market, the improved kind everyone here plants, the red long ones the dealers buy. I put the base fertilizer, the compound one, maybe 2 bags per mu — that is 100 jin, so 50 kg. Then urea two times during the season, one bag maybe 40 jin each mu. Chili is thirsty, I water from my well many times, maybe 8 times through the summer. The bugs and the disease on chili are bad — I spray maybe 6 or 7 times, aphids and the rotting disease. I plough with the small tractor man who comes, 40 yuan per mu.

For cotton, I do like before. Base fertilizer one bag and a half. Urea one time. Water 3 times. Spray for bollworm and aphid maybe 5 times. Rotary till.

Garlic I plant in autumn, harvest in summer. Heavy fertilizer — garlic eats a lot. Compound 2 bags, urea after winter. Water 4 times. Spray 2 times. Plough deep.

Watermelon needs much fertilizer and care. Compound 2 bags and some manure if I can get from the neighbor with sheep. Water 5 times. Spray 4 times for the vine disease.

Wheat is simple. Base one bag, urea in spring one bag. Water 2 times, the spring water and the grain-filling water. Spray 1 time for aphids. Rotary till after maize... no, after my summer crop.

I would rather put a little more fertilizer than lose the harvest. Harvest bad means no money for the whole year.
